d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how the fatal shooting of 15-year-old Javits Frimpong while walking to school in the Bronx has sent shockwaves through communities from New York to Ghana. Following a direct appeal from New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani to US President Donald Trump, the teen’s grieving mother, Doris Adu Gyamfi, was granted an emergency visa to travel to the United States for her son's funeral.
